protected_definition: A payment created through the Builtegrity protected flow for which successful-payment history and the exact locked gross Builtegrity application fee were confirmed by the processor. PROTECTED is historical truth and remains PROTECTED after later refunds or application-fee refunds. Only PROTECTED transactions may recognize Builtegrity transaction revenue.
observed_definition: A processor transaction Builtegrity detected or monitored but did not create/control and from which Builtegrity did not collect a transaction fee. OBSERVED records do not create Builtegrity transaction revenue.
imported_definition: Historical or externally supplied transaction data brought into Builtegrity after the fact for archival/reference purposes. IMPORTED records do not create Builtegrity transaction revenue.
transaction_funding_rule: Merchants and partners are never separately billed by Builtegrity. Protected-flow revenue must be collected inside the successful processor transaction. PENDING_PROTECTED is an internal pre-confirmation state; FEE_EXCEPTION means successful-payment truth exists but required gross application-fee truth is missing or mismatched and the transaction must not be called PROTECTED until resolved.
refund_accounting_rule: Refunds never rewrite original gross transaction history. Customer refunds and Builtegrity application-fee refunds are append-only financial adjustments. Gross Builtegrity fee earned at protection confirmation is historical; current retained application-fee cash may decline later.

tax_season_principles.merchant_tax_form_filer_expectation: Stripe is expected to file eligible Standard Connect merchant 1099-K forms; Express, Custom, Unified, unknown, or changed Stripe configurations require review and cannot silently enter the V1 protected-payment lane.
tax_season_principles.gross_reporting_rule: Gross payment volume is never reduced by processor fees, Builtegrity fees, refunds, disputes, or other adjustments in the gross line. Adjustments are shown separately.
tax_season_principles.sensitive_tax_identity_rule: Do not collect or store raw SSN, EIN, or TIN in the Builtegrity transaction database solely for tax-season reporting. Preserve Stripe as the tax-identity system of record unless a future reviewed legal obligation requires otherwise.
tax_season_principles.state_threshold_rule: Federal reference thresholds are advisory only; state rules can differ and must not be inferred from the federal rule table.
tax_season_principles.partner_compensation_rule: If partner compensation is later paid, partner identity and actual payment/reversal events must be snapshotted in an append-only compensation ledger before tax-form automation is considered.

accounted_definition: All required commercial context, consent evidence, processor payment records, economics, and the supported payout trail have been captured with no unresolved exception.
complete_definition: All expected lifecycle information through the supported processor payout state has been captured. COMPLETE is a current lifecycle state, not a guarantee that no later refund, dispute, adjustment, or payout failure can occur.
